name: synthetic-anthro
description: A deterministic, download-free stand-in for an anthropogenic inventory: three Gaussian urban plumes placed relative to the domain's own latitude/longitude extent plus a weak uniform background, so any domain emits. For runs without network; never a substitute for a real inventory in a forecast that is read for air quality.
licence: WOOF data (no third-party content): an analytic pattern, no inventory values are copied.
attribution: WOOF synthetic anthropogenic emissions (analytic urban plumes); not an emission inventory.
provenance: Field f at a point = peak_f x (background_fraction + sum_k scale_k exp(-d_k^2 / (2 sigma_k^2))), d_k the great-circle distance (earth_radius_m) to plume k, whose centre sits at fraction at = [latitude, longitude] of the domain's point extent (longitudes unwrapped about their circular mean), computed in float64 by woof.chem_inventory_frames. Every field shares the one shape, so the speciation's differences (pm25 - bc - 1.3 oc = 0.46 pm25-peak; pm10 - pm25) stay positive everywhere. Peaks are of the order of EDGAR v8.1's 2022 0.1-degree maxima over Glasgow and Edinburgh (kg m-2 s-1: CO 1.1e-9, NOx 6.4e-10 to 8.8e-10, NH3 8.0e-11 (Glasgow; Edinburgh's 7e-10 is one agricultural/industrial cell), NMVOC 8.8e-10 to 9.8e-10, SO2 2.5e-10 (Glasgow), BC 1.5e-11 to 2.1e-11, OC 2.4e-11 to 3.1e-11, PM2.5 9.4e-11 to 1.2e-10, PM10 1.1e-10 to 1.2e-10), rounded; the 1 % background is of the order of EDGAR's rural Scottish lower quartile relative to those maxima. Constant in time (no diurnal, weekly or seasonal profile).
